definitions.gloss: rapeseed; canola; the seeds of the rape plant
definitions.explanation: The seeds of the rape plant (Brassica napus), widely cultivated for producing cooking oil. The bright yellow blossoms of the rapeseed plant are an iconic symbol of spring in Japan.

notes:
The seeds of the rape plant (Brassica napus), widely cultivated for vegetable oil production. The yellow-flowered ⟦{菜|な}の{花|はな}→菜の花：14042_nanohana⟧ (rapeseed blossom) is an iconic symbol of spring in Japan. The oil extracted from the seeds, {菜種油|なたねあぶら}, is one of the most commonly used cooking oils.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {菜種油|なたねあぶら}: rapeseed oil, canola oil
- {菜種|なたね}{梅雨|づゆ}: spring rain during rapeseed flowering season (March-April)
- {菜種|なたね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧: to press rapeseed (for oil)
- {菜種|なたね}{畑|ばたけ}: rapeseed field

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{菜|な}の{花|はな}→菜の花：14042_nanohana⟧: rapeseed blossoms — the flowers of the same plant, often eaten as a vegetable
- ⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧: soybean — another oilseed crop important in Japanese cuisine
